<text id="342:428" name="Problem Space" x="0" y="0" width="205" height="48" />

<text id="342:429" name="Today's platforms are built for engagement, not meaningful relationships. Social media allows creators to build large communities but offers little control over personal interactions, while traditional dating apps prioritize discovery at scale over trust and compatibility. This creates a gap for creators who want to build genuine connections without compromising their privacy, and for users who seek authentic interactions beyond public comments and endless swiping. InfluCrush was conceived to bridge this gap by creating a relationship platform centered around trust, intentional access, and creator control." x="81" y="128.5" width="588" height="250" />

name: Heading 1
raw: <frame id="342:431" name="Heading 1" x="0" y="0" width="567" height="48">
<text id="342:432" name="Key Challenges" x="0" y="0" width="209" height="48" />

<text id="342:433" name="For Users Meaningful conversations are difficult to initiate in crowded social platforms, while traditional dating apps often encourage superficial interactions. For Creators Managing thousands of unsolicited messages makes it challenging to identify genuine connection requests while maintaining personal boundaries. For Existing Platforms Current products solve either audience engagement or matchmaking, but neither supports structured, trust-first relationships between creators and their communities." x="0" y="72" width="653" height="275" />

<text id="354:64" name="Opportunity" x="0" y="0" width="164" height="48" />

<text id="354:65" name="The rise of the creator economy has changed how people build trust online, but meaningful interactions still happen through public comments or overcrowded inboxes. Existing dating platforms solve discovery, while social platforms solve reach. Neither is designed for intentional relationships between creators and their communities. InfluCrush explores the opportunity to bridge that gap by combining creator control, trust-first interactions, and a premium relationship experience." x="81" y="98.5" width="588" height="175" />
